summary: Successfully developed Agent FinZ - a comprehensive CLI tool for daily premarket financial reports

deliverables.description: Complete TypeScript-based CLI with commander.js framework
Integration with Alpha Vantage, IEX Cloud, and Polygon APIs
Service to fetch and parse earnings reports with premarket filtering
News API integration with OpenAI-powered summarization
Multi-format report generation (console, JSON, HTML, text)
Cron-based daily report scheduling with timezone support
Comprehensive README with usage examples and API documentation
Jest test setup with sample test cases

key_features: 5-minute premarket reports with market data, earnings, and news
Multiple API providers with automatic fallbacks
AI-powered news summarization using OpenAI GPT
Multiple output formats (console, JSON, HTML, text)
Comprehensive CLI with config management and connection testing
TypeScript with ESM modules and strict type checking
commands_implemented: finz report - Generate current premarket report
finz schedule - Manage daily scheduled reports
api_integrations: Alpha Vantage - Market data and earnings

build_instructions: npm link - Make CLI globally available
